Title: Did El Chapo Order $100 Mil Hit On Trump?
Did notorious cartel boss Joaquín 'El Chapo' Guzmán Loera put out a contract on Republican presidential candidate Donald Trump?
On Monday, state-funded media outlet TeleSur shared a rumor that El Chapo had put a $100 million bounty on Trump’s head.
He is reportedly a billionaire, and has been ranked on Forbes’ list of the world’s richest people.
Guzmán has also reportedly ordered hits of Americans before, including an FBI agent.
Trump claims that the two have beef.

After the alleged Sinaloa cartel leader escaped from a high security prison in Mexico, and after Trump made disparaging remarks about Mexicans, Trump told reporters that El Chapo had issued death threats against him.
The business mogul responded with threats of his own on social media, and reported the messages suspected to come from El Chapo to the FBI.
The website is literally called the Conspiracy Club.

On June 20, 2015, conspiracyclub.com published a story with the headline “El Chapo Puts $100 Million Bounty on Donald Trump Dead Or Alive!” It quoted an anonymous inmate with no biographical details or additional sources.
